Life is full of small surprises. Eva's birthday is in April. Amy bought a dress at the shop yesterday. The moon is bright tonight.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the temple fair by bike. They took many photos at the lantern street. Amy learned a lot about history. Also, she ordered a large scoop of vanilla ice cream.
Eva is interested in singing. Both of them like chicken and coffee. Amy's favorite animal is the dog. They adopted a puppy from the shelter.
Amy wrote about the day in the diary. Last Wednesday, Amy and Eva went to the temple fair. Amy and Eva had great fun there.
